verdicts.reason: A keeps the original structure and hierarchy (headline, subhead, badges, legal on one left edge, CTA on the right), but it is just the original spread vertically: the gaps between rows are loose and uneven, the can floats low inside the circle, and the legal line is tiny. B makes the headline bigger, but it nearly touches the right edge. It moves the badges above the headline, which competes with it, and leaves the subhead with 'Friday.' orphaned on its own line. The Order Now button is indented off the text column's left edge, the legal text is crammed beside it at an illegible size, and there is dead space along the bottom.
